extracted.name: Greek Lemon Potatoes
extracted.description: Slow roasted lemony Greek potatoes are the ultimate side dish. Potatoes are roasted with lemon, mustard, oregano, and olive oil until they melt in your mouth.
ingredient_lines: 6 large yellow potatoes, peeled and cut into thin wedges
1 pinch salt and ground black pepper to taste
instruction_lines: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).
Arrange potatoes in a single layer in a large baking dish or roasting pan.
Mix water, lemon juice, olive oil, mustard, oregano, salt, and pepper together. Pour over the potatoes and stir to coat.
Bake in the preheated oven, carefully turning over halfway through, until potatoes are tender and nearly all excess liquid has evaporated, 75 to 90 minutes.
